# Psalm 52 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 52:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** You-love all words-of devouring, O-tongue of-deceit.
- **LOGOS:** You love all words that devour, O deceitful tongue.
- **PNEUMA:** You love to destroy others with your words, you liar!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 52:6 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** Also God tears-you-down forever; He-snatches-you and-tears-you from-the-tent, and-uproots-you from-the-land of-the-living. Selah.
- **LOGOS:** But God will break you down forever; He will snatch you and tear you from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah.
- **PNEUMA:** But God will strike you down once and for all. He will pull you from your home and uproot you from the land of the living. Pause and reflect.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** But-I [am] like-a-green olive-tree in-the-house of-God; I-trust in-the-steadfast-love of-God forever and-ever.

- **PNEUMA:** But I am like an olive tree, thriving in the house of God. I will always trust in God's unfailing love.
